room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day OR Room Category (Twin Sharing or Single Private AC)
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies which applies: Room Rent = 1% of SI/day, OR Room Category 1 = Twin Sharing, OR Room Category 2 = Single Private AC. Pro-rata deduction on associate expenses if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU Charges Option 1 = 2% of Benefit 1 SI per day; ICU Charges Option 2 = no limit. Policy Schedule specifies which applies.

copayment.note: Co-payment per claim as specified in Policy Schedule (illustration shows 20%/30%). Increases by 10% per claim year after insured/eldest turns 71. Waiver of age-71 loading available on extra premium if first policy issued at age ≤70. Co-pay not applicable on Benefit 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, Optional Cover 2 & 3.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, knee replacement, hernia, hysterectomy, BPH, renal stones, CVD, cancer, renal complications, bone fractures capped
sub_limits.note: Named Ailments/Procedures (Clause 3.1.1(c)(iii)) have sub-limits specified in Schedule of Benefits. Domiciliary capped at 10% of SI. Dialysis capped per sitting.

deductible.display: As per Policy Schedule (may be nil or specified amount)
deductible.note: Deductible is applicable on all Benefits except Benefit 7 & 9. Actual amount per Policy Schedule. Illustrations show plans with co-pay; deductible amount not explicitly stated in wording text.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 24 months of continuous coverage. Portability credit applicable.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, BPH, hysterectomy, kidney stones, varicose veins, cancer, etc.) excluded for 24 months from first policy date.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered under Benefit 1.

cumulative_bonus.note: Cumulative Bonus is defined in the policy but no rate or cap is stated in the wording text provided.

restoration.display: Once/year, up to 100% of SI (unrelated illness/injury only)
restoration.note: Benefit 7: Recharge of Sum Insured activated once SI is fully exhausted; not available for same illness/injury already claimed in that policy year. Cannot be carried forward. Not applicable to Optional Covers.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for the period immediately prior to admission; no expenses before Policy Start Date. Exact number of days per Schedule of Benefits (wording references 'pre-defined number of days'; illustration context suggests 30 days).

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for pre-defined days after discharge; no expenses incurred 30+ days after Policy End Date. Exact days per Schedule of Benefits.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (541 listed in Annexure I)

domiciliary.note: Benefit 6: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered up to 10% of SI; must exceed 3 consecutive days. Several chronic conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: Benefit 10: AYUSH treatments covered up to Sum Insured via cashless or reimbursement at registered AYUSH hospitals; admissible only if Benefit 1 in-patient claim is also admissible.

organ_donor.note: Expenses related to donor treatment including surgery to remove organs from donor are permanently excluded (Clause 4.2(i)(12)).

ambulance.display: Up to limit in Schedule of Benefits
ambulance.note: Benefit 5: Reasonable and Customary Charges for road ambulance to nearest hospital in emergency; exact rupee limit per Schedule of Benefits.

modern_treatments.note: Clause 3.1.1(d) covers 12 specified advanced technology methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.). Other advance technology methods are excluded.

consumables.display: Benefit 2: Consumable Allowance (fixed daily amount, inbuilt)
consumables.note: Benefit 2 pays a fixed amount per 24-hour period of in-patient hospitalisation (from day 4 to day 7 max per illness). Not applicable for first 3 days or beyond 7 consecutive days. Amount per Schedule of Benefits.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only (Clause 6.1.6(a) and Specific Exclusion 15).

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Applies to original SI; fresh 5-year period on enhanced SI for the enhanced portion.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments during policy period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, maternity, organ donor expenses, non-allopathic (except AYUSH inpatient), treatment outside India, 16 permanent pre-existing conditions (e.g. DVT, varicose veins, retinal detachment), Remicade/Avastin injections, multifocal lens

optional_riders.display: Optional Cover 1: Good Health+ (OPD consultations & pharmacy discounts); Optional Cover 2: Home Care (nurse hire ₹1,000/day up to 45 days/yr); Optional Cover 3: Health Check+ (enhanced annual health check-up)
